host.label: WeatherLink Live IP address
host.help: Local IP address of the WeatherLink Live device, e.g. 192.168.1.50

discoverButton.label: Find WeatherLink Live
discoverButton.help: Searches the local network for a WeatherLink Live via mDNS/Bonjour and fills in its IP address and port automatically

error.notFound: No WeatherLink Live found on the local network. Make sure the device and this ioBroker host are on the same network and multicast is not blocked, then enter the IP address manually.
error.discoveryFailed: Discovery failed, see the adapter log for details.

pollInterval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.help: Minimum 10 seconds as required by the WeatherLink Live Local API

units.label: Units
units.help: The WeatherLink Live always reports values in imperial units; select "Metric" to convert temperature (°C), wind speed (km/h) and pressure (hPa) before storing them

realtimeEnabled.label: Enable real-time mode (UDP broadcast)
realtimeEnabled.help: Requests the WeatherLink Live to broadcast wind and rain data every 2.5s over UDP

realtimeDuration.label: Real-time broadcast duration (seconds)
realtimeDuration.help: Duration requested per activation; will be renewed automatically. Max 86400
